author: MeinGrein
body:
Hello,

    I am sending this ban appeal because I got banned for a miss taken reason. On July 31, I asked a MOD, "_Poseidon__" to unban a player, my brother (dimitris and now his name is dim123) and then  "_Poseidon__" decided to ban me for ban evading.

Thank you,   andreas_pap
